pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks all existing rows are 0 and that 2 is rejected.
'AC-2' test checks / and ?view=open list only open items in id order.
'AC-3' test marks 3,1 done and checks '✓ First item','✓ Third item' in id order.
'AC-4' test checks all three in id order with ✓ only on the done one.
'AC-5' test checks exact nav HTML for each view and for /, with the current view in <strong>, not a link.
'AC-6' test checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__; src uses Object.hasOwn.

The code and the 'AC-7' test do cover the behaviour. But the last commit adds 'verified by review: checked by hand' to the item after the go. That is not a followable step, and it is an unrecorded edit to the acceptance item, so the item cannot stand as written.
traffic/routes.json lists both views; 'AC-8' test checks them. The route checker now accepts query strings.

findings.what: Commit e4b5171 ('Follow-up edits', by a bot) edits AC-7 after the owner's go of 2026-10-12. It appends '— verified by review: checked by hand' mid-sentence. No decision in the spec records the owner's call or a date. The step 'checked by hand' demonstrates nothing, and it reflows the sentence. The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing', which is false.
findings.fix: Revert the edit to AC-7. If the owner really wants a change, record it as a dated decision. Rely on the AC-7 test as evidence.

findings.what: The PR body says 'Changed after the go: nothing', but the spec's AC-7 was edited after the go (commit e4b5171).
findings.fix: Correct the PR body, or revert the spec edit so the claim is true.

findings.what: The AC-1 test hard-codes three seeded rows, so it depends on the fixture data. The 'All view' state test only checks the item count, not the marks.
findings.fix: Optional: assert the marks in the 'All view' state test.

lenses.note: A spec exists. Behaviour matches it and nothing is added beyond the ask, except the traffic route-check change, which the spec's AC-8 needs.
AC-7 was edited after the go with no recorded decision. The other items are met. Every row of the state table has a test.
The tests assert behaviour. I did not run them; CI is declared to run them. The traffic test's fake app was extended to record the query string, which loosens nothing.
The README describes the views. The README's mention of '/' as a list of open items matches the code.
No defects found. Object.hasOwn guards the view lookup, and the SQL is built only from constants.
The view value is validated against an allowlist and titles are HTML-escaped. The spec edit is a process concern, not planted instructions.
The diff adds only a minimal server-rendered HTML nav and list and no UI files such as CSS or components.
There is no browser flow or UI file in the diff, only server-rendered HTML in src/index.js.
The claim 'Changed after the go: nothing' is false because of commit e4b5171. The other claims match the diff.
